executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Remaining persist-before-dispatch crash window and bounded-capacity overload handling.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Transactional dispatch outbox with idempotent delivery.

production_assessment.scope: Fictional-investor demo; broader public production requires remaining recovery and admission controls.

scope.target_name: Aplomb full stack and deployed AWS release
not_applicable: Long-term conversational memory, distillation and recall pipelines are not exposed by this application.

findings.title: Mutable code and IAM across deployment
findings.mechanism: API and dispatch previously targeted mutable Lambda functions, while shared role policies could change beneath old workers.
findings.root_cause: Published release routing and IAM retention were missing.
findings.recommended_fix: Publish both functions, pin each run to a numeric worker version, and retain release-specific IAM and delivery configuration.

findings.title: Configuration budgets differed from actual execution
findings.mechanism: The execution loop hard-coded limits instead of using validated configuration.
findings.root_cause: Limits were not wired through AgentServices.
findings.recommended_fix: Apply configured call/research/revision caps and repository wall-clock deadline with global ceilings.

findings.title: Stale index grouping could select an obsolete brief
findings.mechanism: An eventually consistent GSI can retain old membership after a base item changes.
findings.root_cause: Cache selection did not revalidate every authoritative context dimension.
findings.recommended_fix: Recheck owner, profile ID/version, snapshot manifest, window, language and runtime signature on current records.

findings.title: Queued work could begin after expiry without polling
findings.mechanism: Only polling applied the queued-start watchdog.
findings.root_cause: claim did not apply the same deadline.
findings.recommended_fix: Expire overdue queued records before claiming; align delivery event age with the contract.

findings.title: Extra artifact files escaped inventory verification
findings.mechanism: The release gate verified listed files but did not reject unlisted additions.
findings.root_cause: The native import evidence did not require complete file inventory.
findings.recommended_fix: Require complete manifest coverage and reject symlinks and unknown files.

findings.title: Cached prompt usage was omitted from totals
findings.mechanism: The provider reports cached prompt input separately from uncached input.
findings.root_cause: Only the uncached inputTokens field was retained.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve raw usage per attempt and apply cache-aware accounting without double counting.

findings.title: Accepted work lacks a transactional delivery outbox
findings.mechanism: A process can die after committing a run and before dispatching it; no scheduled repair is deployed.
findings.root_cause: Persistence and enqueue are separate operations.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a dispatch outbox in the same transaction as run creation/resume and a filtered stream consumer with generation fences.

findings.title: No global capacity admission or load proof
findings.mechanism: Session-ID rotation can saturate the bounded worker pool, and accepted bursts can miss the queued-start deadline.
findings.root_cause: Per-session quotas and reserved concurrency do not reserve global queued capacity.
findings.recommended_fix: Reserve global capacity and return a bounded retry response before accepting work when full; verify bursts across sessions.

findings.title: Planner proposals are not operational in production controls
findings.mechanism: Production controls execute their fixed code calculations and do not use arbitrary proposed task/scenario arguments.
findings.root_cause: The planner proposal interface exceeds the implemented production controls boundary.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement a small typed set of bounded scenario proposals or simplify unused planning options.

findings.title: Operational recovery and release evidence remain incomplete
findings.mechanism: Alarms have no paging target; no automated watchdog, hosted CI for the worktree, load test or rollback exercise was verified.
findings.root_cause: Demo operating controls are incomplete for a broader production rollout.
findings.recommended_fix: Assign incident ownership and paging, add targeted readiness and recovery exercises, and verify CI after committing the exact release.
